question: Does evolved reproductive assurance more strongly reduce the marginal maternal+paternal return to floral investment where effective pollination remains high than where it is already constrained?
theoretical_source: PR #411 confirmed four-setting assurance non-necessity and divergence attenuation; explanatory fixed-resident rare-mutant gradient is not field-calibrated.

independent_empirical_resources.evidence: species-level island flora reproductive traits and independent GloPL pollen-supplementation experiments
independent_empirical_resources.role: broad ecological context, NOT same-site longitudinal inherited response

independent_empirical_resources.evidence: 125 unique plants and 218 measured C. microdonta corollas across five Izu Islands
independent_empirical_resources.role: existing within-lineage phenotype, NOT independent pollinator or reproductive output observations

observational_data_status: Unknown/missing until raw joint visitor→fitness→genotype files are verified. Never count existing corolla measurements as new pollination or fitness observations.

visit_effectiveness: legitimate contact with stigma and anthers per observed visit
visitor taxon/functional guild and body size when measurable
visitor richness and raw encounter rate as secondary, not service surrogate
mating_and_reproductive_assurance: tagged plant identity stable across treatments
controlled-self and controlled-cross treatments with offspring viability
selfed-vs-outcrossed progeny genetic assignment or verified breeding evidence
self-compatibility separate from realized autonomous selfing
floral_investment: matching field-measured corolla dimensions and guide coverage by tagged plant
measured cost proxy or measured energetic reproductive allocation; no automatic mapping from morphology to Model I
mouth/throat geometry and reproductive-organ length separately; size-corrected traits not collapsed into generalized attraction
paternal_component: donor-assigned siring from progeny, or a validated pollen export proxy with known limitations
maternal and paternal contributions kept separate in readout
demography_and_history: plant census/survival and tagged mother recruitment across repeated seasons
population origin/native status and island colonization history where independently known
repeat years and/or pedigrees to distinguish selection from among-species sorting
seed immigration and pollinator recolonization documented separately

candidate_primary_test.measure: On the same tagged-plant observation units, compare the slope of realized lifetime viable genetic contribution against a predeclared plant-investment proxy at measured high versus low effective visitor service, conditional on reproductive assurance A.
candidate_primary_test.formulation: Let beta_I(A,V) be the partial slope of inclusive parental output (0.5 viable female outcross + 0.5 assigned paternal outcross + viable selfed) with respect to I. Candidate interaction [beta_I(A_high,V_high)-beta_I(A_low,V_high)] - [beta_I(A_high,V_low)-beta_I(A_low,V_low)] is negative in the model baseline settings.
candidate_primary_test.nature: Observational selection-gradient confrontation, not automatic causal identification. Experimental manipulation/parentage needed for causal transport.
candidate_primary_test.must_not_use: Isolation-distance threshold as substitute for measured visitor service, self-compatibility as realized selfing, flower size as full Model I, population seed-set alone as both sexes' genetic fitness.

assembly_vs_evolution.assembly_estimand: Composition of newly arriving/establishing species by self-compatibility/assurance controlling source pool (Chapter1-style); NO within-lineage transformation claim.
assembly_vs_evolution.within_lineage_estimand: Repeated genetic/phenotypic state and selection within existing plant lineage/populations over time (Izu system if eventually measured).
assembly_vs_evolution.survivor_filter: Account for disappearances/censoring without replacing missing trait endpoints with zero.

minimum_analysis_gates: Treat flower records as nested within tagged plants and sites; never use 218 flowers as 218 independent plants.
Never fit the proposed interaction if any of A, I, validated visitor effectiveness or maternal and paternal fitness contributions remain unmeasured.
Predeclare I proxy and A assay before reading future reproductive outcomes.
Separate self-incompatible, self-compatible, autonomous and realized selfing categories.
Preserve all observed sites, islands, flowering stages and unmatched records in an exclusion ledger.
Use site/population replication for selection inference; no ecological inference from five island labels alone.
Do not infer causation from contemporaneous island syndrome or transfer coefficients from synthetic coordinates to natural units.
Null or opposite observed interactions count as falsification/transport failure; do not retune the model.
Any no-data status is not evidence of model support.
next_available_action: Build a joint plant-level cross-repository data inventory and mark measured vs missing fields. Do not fabricate observations.
journal_boundary: The active Ecology Letters four-setting simulated contrast is independent; the field bridge is a separate prospective claim, not a retroactive validation.
